If density of a gas is measured at constant temperature and pressure then which of the following statement is correct ?

options.label: A
options.text: Density is directly proportional to molar mass of the gas.

options.label: B
options.text: Greater the density greater is the molar mass of the gas.

options.label: C
options.text: If density, temperature and pressure is given ideal gas equation can be used to find molar mass.

options.label: D
options.text: All the above statements are correct.

_note: p-22 (printed p.157), right column. ⚠ This item sits inside the block headed `2. Answer in one sentence.` but is MCQ-SHAPED — a `which of the following statement is correct` stem with four printed alternatives a-d. Committed as an MCQ on its shape, per the brief's rule to key on block shape rather than an instruction phrase.
